description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'LeaveEntitlementDaoTest' that tests the 'LeaveEntitlementDao' class within the OrangeHRM system. The tests cover various data retrieval, creation, update, deletion, and reporting functions related to employee leave entitlements, including filtering, sorting, and entitlement matching.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing LeaveEntitlementDao functions, including filtering, CRUD operations, entitlement matching, and report data retrieval within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, including creating a LeaveEntitlementDao instance, setting up fixture paths, and populating test data.

methods.name: _compareEntitlements
methods.description: Helper method to compare two lists of LeaveEntitlement objects for equality.

methods.name: _compareEntitlement
methods.description: Helper method to compare two LeaveEntitlement objects for equality.

methods.name: _verifyDeletedFlags
methods.description: Verifies that specified leave entitlement IDs are marked as deleted and others are not.
